Multiple Dictionary Support for Every Word Game

Different word games accept different word lists, which is why our unscrambler supports three major dictionaries. The ENABLE dictionary (English Word List) covers standard English words accepted in most casual play. The TWL (Tournament Word List) includes valid words for North American Scrabble competitions, incorporating specific word choices favored in competitive tournaments. The CSW (Collins Scrabble Words) dictionary represents international play standards, particularly for UK and international tournaments. By supporting all three dictionaries, you can confidently play across any platform knowing that your words are valid in that specific context. Simply select your preferred dictionary from our interface and search—the unscramble function immediately filters results to match your chosen word list.
